retrieve_chunks.heading: Creating a Verification Environment
retrieve_chunks.text: To create a verification environment for a new project, generate the environment skeleton with the template generator, then configure the project manifest with the block's interfaces and clock domains. Connect one interface agent per port listed in the manifest and register the environment with the project build system before writing any tests.

retrieve_chunks.heading: Environment Bring-up Checks
retrieve_chunks.text: After the skeleton compiles, run the bring-up checks in order: the smoke compile, the connectivity test that toggles every connected interface once, and the sanity sequence that drives a minimal transaction through the environment. All three must pass before the environment is considered created.

script.answer_draft: To create a verification environment for a new project: (1) generate the environment skeleton with the template generator, (2) configure the project manifest with the block's interfaces and clock domains, (3) connect one interface agent per manifest port and register the environment with the project build system, then (4) run the bring-up checks — smoke compile, connectivity test, and the sanity sequence — all of which must pass before the environment is considered created. [1][2]

retrieve_chunks.heading: Hooking the Environment into Regression
retrieve_chunks.text: Once the bring-up checks pass, add the environment to the project regression list so the sanity sequence runs in every nightly. Tag the environment's tests with the block name so regression reports group failures per environment, and set the nightly seed rotation policy in the regression config.

retrieve_chunks.heading: Regression Flow Overview
retrieve_chunks.text: The regression flow schedules every registered environment nightly, rotating seeds per the policy in the regression config, and publishes grouped pass/fail reports per environment tag the next morning.

script.answer_draft: Going further: once the bring-up checks pass, hook the environment into regression — add it to the project regression list so the sanity sequence runs in every nightly, tag its tests with the block name so reports group failures per environment, and set the nightly seed rotation policy in the regression config. The regression flow then schedules the environment nightly and publishes grouped pass/fail reports per tag. [1][2]

retrieve_chunks.heading: Sign-off Flow Overview
retrieve_chunks.text: The design sign-off flow runs four gated stages in order: timing sign-off, power sign-off, physical verification, and formal equivalence checking. A stage may not start until the previous stage's deliverable is signed by the block owner and the sign-off lead.

retrieve_chunks.heading: Sign-off Deliverables
retrieve_chunks.text: Each sign-off stage produces one deliverable: the timing sign-off report, the power sign-off report, the physical verification clean report, and the equivalence check log. All four are archived with the release tag.

script.answer_draft: The design sign-off flow runs four gated stages in order — timing sign-off, power sign-off, physical verification, and formal equivalence checking — where each stage may only start once the previous stage's deliverable is signed by the block owner and the sign-off lead. Each stage produces one archived deliverable: the timing sign-off report, the power sign-off report, the physical verification clean report, and the equivalence check log. [1][2]
